title: Bounded-above flat complexes on a ringed site are K-flat
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$. Every bounded-above complex of flat sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules] is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex].
